_comment: Role scoping is enforced in two places since 2.6.1. In the session, a Claude Code hook refuses edits to an operator's paths_denied (and holds anyone it cannot identify to the operator role). At the pull request, the boundary check fails a PR that changes those paths until a founder approves its head commit, reading this policy from the base branch. Identity comes from the authenticated GitHub CLI; role comes from the people map in .aios/config.json. What neither stops: a direct push to main, which only branch protection prevents - see scripts/team/verify-branch-protection.sh.

operator.summary: run the day, ship the work, hand it over cleanly

founder.summary: own the brain, the money and the gates
